candidates.exact_span: Pollutant limits - The concentration of the pollutants in the municipal sewage sludge is at or below the values listed.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes the operative compliance standard (concentration at or below listed values) for determining whether reported sludge pollutant measurements exceed applicable limits.
Specifies that limits are monthly averages in mg/kg; a different reading of averaging period or units would change which limit value applies and which monitoring results are comparable.
Defines the concentration basis for limit comparison; interpreting measurements on a wet-weight or other basis differently would change exceedance determinations.

Molybdenum has no numeric limit—only a reporting obligation. Interpretation affects whether numeric compliance comparison applies (A), whether monitoring/reporting is required (B), and how missing or non-numeric results are classified (C).

candidates.exact_span: All bulk sewage sludge that is applied to agricultural land, forest, a public contact site, a reclamation site, or lawn or home garden shall be treated by the Class A pathogen reduction requirements as defined above in Element I, Section I.B.3. All bagged sewage sludge must be treated by Class A pathogen reduction requirements.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Pathogen-control obligations are conditional on sludge use (bulk land application type vs. bagged). Different readings of applicability conditions change which monitoring/treatment requirements are in force and how periods without applicable obligations are classified.

candidates.exact_span: The concentration (mg/Kg) in the sludge of each pollutant listed in Table 3 and the applicable pollutant concentration criteria listed in Table 3.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Recordkeeping obligation to document concentrations and applicable criteria; interpretation of what must be retained affects whether monitoring evidence is expected to exist and how missing or undocumented results are treated.

candidates.exact_span: A certification statement that all applicable requirements (specifically listed) have been met, and that the permittee understands that there are significant penalties for false certification including fine and imprisonment. See 503.17(a)(1)(ii) or 503.17(a)(3)(i)(B), whichever applies to the permittees sludge treatment activities.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Certification is required but the applicable cross-reference depends on which sludge treatment activities apply; resolving 'whichever applies' changes which documented compliance evidence is expected and how gaps are classified.

candidates.exact_span: A description of how the Class A pathogen reduction requirements are met.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes a documentation obligation for pathogen control; whether this evidence is required and present affects monitoring-obligation resolution and missing-evidence classification.

candidates.exact_span: A description of how the vector attraction reduction requirements are met.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Vector attraction reduction is required for recordkeeping though not restated in Item 2 operative limits; interpretation of whether and when this obligation applies changes monitoring/documentation expectations and missing-evidence handling.

candidates.exact_span: Pollutant Table 3 appropriate for permittee's land application practices.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Which Table 3 pollutants must be reported depends on land application practices; different applicability readings change which parameters have enforceable limits and which monitoring/reporting obligations attach.

candidates.exact_span: The frequency of monitoring listed in Element 1, Section I.C. which applies to the permittee.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Monitoring frequency is defined by an external cross-reference; resolving which Element 1, Section I.C. provisions apply changes whether monitoring was required for a given period.

TCLP compliance is pass/fail rather than numeric; interpretation affects whether numeric limit comparison applies, whether TCLP monitoring is required, and how non-numeric or missing TCLP results are classified.

candidates.exact_span: The concentration (mg/Kg) in the sludge of each pollutant listed in Table 1 (defined as a monthly average) found in Element 1, Section I. In addition, the applicable pollutant concentration criteria listed in Table 3 should be included on the DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: DMR reporting references both Table 1 (Element 1) concentrations and Table 3 criteria; resolving which table governs reported values vs. compliance limits changes exceedance comparisons, monitoring scope, and how mismatched or missing cross-referenced data is interpreted.
